hermes.goal: Beat buy-and-hold (positive alpha vs BTC) while keeping max drawdown under 15% and never risking the mandate on a single trade — capital preservation first. Near-term: prove a sustained, fee-aware, positive out-of-sample edge on the paper trainer over ~90 days before scaling any live capital; grow the live account only on demonstrated alpha.

brain.commentary: Risk-on regime supports measured exposure, but the council provides limited constructive evidence: BTC and ETH are flat with negative composites, while SOL and LTC are materially weaker and carry higher model risk. XRP, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, BCH, UNI, XLM, and ETC are fragile signals because they share identical conviction/composite values and report zero volatility, expected shortfall, alpha, and liquidity data—consistent with a default or stale data path. Keep aggregate risk below normal and avoid treating those long signals as differentiated conviction.
